shareText:
🎬 Jesse & Céline — Before Sunrise / Before Sunset

Jesse and Céline are the central couple of Richard Linklater’s Before trilogy, portrayed by Ethan Hawke and Julie Delpy. Their story begins when they meet by chance on a train and decide to spend one night walking around Vienna together, talking about life, love, relationships, fears, and everything in between.

In Before Sunrise, their connection develops almost entirely through conversation. They know they have only a limited amount of time together, which makes every moment feel temporary. Instead of immediately defining what they are, they simply enjoy being around each other and discovering who the other person really is.

Nine years later, Before Sunset reunites them in Paris. They are no longer the same people they were in Vienna, and both have lived completely different lives. Yet the chemistry between them returns almost instantly, along with all the feelings they never completely left behind.

What makes Jesse and Céline different from typical movie couples is that their relationship is built around timing, missed opportunities, uncertainty, and the strange feeling of meeting someone who understands you almost too well. Their conversations constantly blur the line between friendship, love, regret, and what could have been.

At its core, their story is about two people who keep finding each other at different points in life—and wondering whether love is about finding the right person, or simply finding them at the right time.

#BeforeSunrise #BeforeSunset #JesseAndCeline #EthanHawke #Cinema

🎬:Off-Campus (Series)

Plot:

Based on the viral book series by Elle Kennedy, the show is set at Briar University and follows the lives of the elite college ice hockey team. Season 1, titled The Deal, focuses on Hannah Wells, a music major who is seemingly the only girl on campus not interested in the hockey team. When star captain Garrett Graham needs to pass a philosophy class to keep his spot on the team, he strikes a deal with Hannah: she tutors him, and he helps her win over her crush by pretending to date her. As their fake relationship plays out in the public eye, the lines between their agreement and reality begin to blur, forcing both to contront their past traumas and true feelings.

Casting:

[Ella Bright, Belmont Cameli, Josh Heuston, Mika Abdalla, Khobe Clarke, Antonio Cipriano, Jalen Thomas Brooks, Steve Howey]

Crew:

Showrunners: Louisa Levy, Gina Fattore

Writers: Louisa Levy, Gina Fattore (Based on the novels by Elle Kennedy)

Executive Producers: Jenny Han, Hope Hartman, Mads

Hansen, Karen Rosenfelt

Production: Amazon MGM Studios

Trivia:

The series follows the "interconnected standalone" format of the books, much like Bridgerton, where each season focuses on a different couple while keeping the core friend group as recurring characters.

Belmont Cameli, who plays Garrett, actually has a background in sports, which helped him prepare for the physically demanding ice hockey sequences.

Author Elle Kennedy served as a consultant on the show to ensure the "Briar University" atmosphere-from the specific hockey house vibes to the witty banter-stayed true to the source material that built a massive following on "BookTok."
